title: Borel measurability of the upper/lower n-densities and their level sets (Simon Ch. 1, 3.2; parent step 8)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and μ an s-finite Borel measure on ℝ^N. Then x ↦ limsup_{ρ↓0} μ(B̄_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) and x ↦ liminf_{ρ↓0} μ(B̄_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) are Borel functions ℝ^N → [0,∞], and for every c ∈ [0,∞] the set {x : Θ^n(μ,x) exists and equals c} is a Borel set.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) [SFinite μ], Measurable (fun x ↦ limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ Measurable (fun x ↦ liminf (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, MeasurableSet {x | HasDensity n μ x c}
